comments.author: @zandrrlife
comments.text: the ACTUAL reality is we are not. These researchers are outright lying. There are multiple papers that empirically prove the "reasoning models" are cap. They don't even use the intermediate 'thoughts' to decrease loss to a final answer. rather the extra tokens allow the model more time to figure out the correct latent path. meaning no reasoning model is actually a reasoning model, rather they are long-context models. Also system-2 thinking doesn't happen in discrete space. even if you generate 1 million thought tokens it still based on system-1 computation. system-2 thinking has to happen in latent space. So I would say, from an empirical perspective, all these labs are full of shi*. The fact none of these labs talk about loop transformers, which is the first step to latent thinkers, model design that more biologically plausible is another reason, I can't take them serious. The cap is insane right now. so to call reasoning models a true breakthrough is reflective of actual reality.
